generalSettings.description: Manage operator branding, Telegram links, support contacts, and order defaults.
generalSettings.systemNameHint: Shown on the login page, sidebar, and public API reference.
generalSettings.botUrlHint: Public https://t.me link for the customer bot.
generalSettings.supportLine1Hint: First support contact shown to customers.
generalSettings.supportLine2Hint: Optional second support contact shown to customers.
generalSettings.timezoneHint: Choose the IANA timezone used by the Telegram bot.
generalSettings.timezoneNote: This timezone controls times shown by the Telegram bot. The dashboard continues to use your browser timezone.
generalSettings.orderPrefixHint: Use 2–8 uppercase letters or digits; it cannot start with TU.
generalSettings.apiDocsUrlHint: Optional public HTTPS address for the API reference.
